body:
CANONICAL, continued from termal-host-workarounds, -2 and -3 (which is at its size limit): live TermAl host workarounds and operating lessons for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each entry names the item whose fix retires it.

2026-11-10 14:46Z (TermAl w-57e42ea8c0e4, p2, refusal text only; Fable2 #7425): a root named or re-named (for example after a lapsed claim retired the old root) takes effect only at the next HOST-DELIVERED turn, meaning a prompt or a mailbox wake. A turn the Claude runtime starts itself after a background-task notice is never admitted (by design, TermAl w-df1ef323efe9 criterion 1), so evaluation refuses named_root_sighting_unavailable. Workaround: after naming, end the turn and wait for a mail or prompt, not a background-task wake. The coordinator sends a one-line continuation mail if needed. Then check from the root and evaluate. Long waits make claims lapse and roots retire, so re-claim and re-name before evaluating. Retire the text part when w-57e4 lands; the turn rule is by design.
RE-NAMED ROOT NEEDS A NEW CHECK (2026-11-12, w-4eabb205c7b2; TermAl w-36d0e270de9d, P1): checks run under the OLD root generation do not count after a re-name. Evaluator 17647, spawned on root 3553 (re-named from 3538), was refused with 409 "the registered check's named root is unavailable or has been rebound; name the intended root and run a new check", and nothing was recorded. After any re-name, run the classified test again from the new root as the LAST run, then evaluate. Retire the wasted-spawn part when w-36d0 makes the preflight refuse before spawning.

2026-11-10: a coordinator's background `sleep` timer counts as unfinished background Claude work and restricts verification credit for its session and workspace (TermAl "Check credit" notice). Never use one as a reminder.

2026-11-10 lesson: never hold work indefinitely on an announced restart. Give any restart-gated hold a deadline, check the hosts' state when it passes, and proceed with whatever can run (see rules-greg-act-holds-2026-11-12).

2026-11-10 17:39Z (TermAl w-1945e23297c9, P2; Fable2 #507): read-only Claude Git inspection can refuse legitimate commands. The tokenizer (src/claude.rs:1496) rejects every unquoted '{', including Git REV^{TYPE}, and merge-base is missing from the read-only Git subcommand list (1775–1816). Until the fix runs, quote the revision ('HEAD^{tree}') or use git log -1 --format=%T%n%P HEAD; for ancestry use git log --oneline A..B, since rev-list may also be refused. This is an inspection workaround, not permission to widen tooling. Related: TermAl w-aabc3b2aa5fb. Retire when w-1945 runs on the host.

RETIRED: the journal-full workaround (409 "named-root journal is full"; limit is now 1024, fixed since 2026-11-11), and the "resume every session after each TermAl restart" workaround (TermAl w-87a2 done 2026-11-11). After a restart, resume only a session whose recovery demonstrably failed. These supersede older entries that still say otherwise.

2026-11-11 03:32Z evaluation lesson (w-658f): on an item with many notes, an independent evaluator can return "insufficient" because the remote test records fall outside its read window. Fix it in criterionEvidence: cite the exact gate evidence ids and the holder note with the proof, not just "see notes". Re-roll once at most; if visibility still fails, report the exact text as a tool problem.

2026-11-11 evaluation-committed-input lesson (w-0d4c): TermAl's evaluation preflight refuses with committed_input_no_eligible_run unless the NEWEST applicable terminal test result on the named root's exact HEAD passed. Earlier candidates' passes don't count.

2026-11-11 (TermAl w-71e95318ea03, P1): there is no supported route to replay a retained, unconfirmed evaluation submission after its evaluator ended. If no evaluation landed, start ONE fresh evaluator; it cannot duplicate a verdict. Retire when w-71e9 lands.

BATCH ORDER FOR EVALUATION PREFLIGHT (2026-11-12; TermAl w-184d1c27edea): the preflight looks at the NEWEST terminal run on the root's HEAD. If that run holds only unclassified stages (readiness, fmt, lint, Clippy, doctor), it refuses with verification_record_unclassified_stages, even when an older classified test PASS exists. Until w-184d is installed, run non-test checks FIRST and the classified test LAST, and nothing unclassified after it. If it happens anyway, rerun the same classified test once on the unchanged commit, then evaluate.
CREDITED TESTS MUST BE DIRECT CARGO TESTS (docs/development.md, test launcher section): run them as `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- cargo test ...`. The Windows wrapper `scripts/test-rust.ps1` is the documented full-suite entry, but its runs are kind `other` and earn no test credit. This is documented behavior, not a TermAl defect.

CODEX DELETE REFUSAL (2026-11-13; TermAl w-c97f4e840563, diagnosed in note 06d9e2df). Codex's own exec policy (codex 0.167.1) treats a delete WITH -Force (also del/erase /f, rd /s) as dangerous. Under approvalPolicy "never" it is refused with "blocked by policy"; under on-request, which TermAl auto-approves, it runs. Sandbox mode doesn't matter. 12325 was on "never", against Greg's 10-17 standard that all Codex lanes use auto-approve; Greg has been asked to switch it (Asistant #1083). RULE: never retry or rewrap a refused command. For path-checked in-repo cleanup, use the delete WITHOUT -Force, or `git worktree remove` without --force. If it is still refused, record it and hand the exact path list to a Claude session or the coordinator, who removes it after the same path check and records it on the item.

2026-11-14 09:21Z (Engram::Opus #4255): a Claude BACKGROUND SUBAGENT (Agent tool with run_in_background) counts as unfinished background work, exactly like a background `sleep`. TermAl restricts check credit for that session and workspace while it runs; Opus's read-only recovery sweep was flagged between 09:15 and 09:21Z. Rule: run such sweeps inline or as a foreground subagent, and never start a background one around a credited check. This is by design, not a TermAl defect.
Same day: a mistaken revise put the body "placeholder" into this key (rev 15, 09:20:52Z). It was restored to rev 14's exact text as rev 16 at 09:21:12Z. Before a revise of a shared memory, read the current text and send the whole new body, or use append.
